name: Singhvi Interiors
description:
Singhvi Interiors is a Mumbai-based interior design firm creating thoughtfully designed residential and commercial spaces. We work with homeowners and businesses to deliver functional, elegant interiors suited to modern living and working needs.

Our services include interior design consultancy, space planning, turnkey execution, interior styling, and 3D visualization services. We provide 3D renders, walkthroughs, and 360-degree views to help clients clearly visualize their spaces before execution. With a focus on quality materials, refined finishes, and smooth project coordination, we ensure a seamless experience from concept to completion.

We aim to create timeless interiors with a stress-free process.

owner_posts.post_text: Looking for premium interior designers ? This modern luxury living room project in Vadodara showcases elegant interior design with contemporary aesthetics, custom furniture, ambient lighting, designer ceilings, and a sophisticated neutral color palette. Thoughtfully planned for comfort and functionality, the space combines modern décor trends with timeless elegance to create a warm and inviting atmosphere. From luxurious seating arrangements to detailed finishing touches, every element reflects high-quality craftsmanship and personalized interior solutions for modern homes.

2025 interiors are moving towards “Quiet Luxury” — clean lines, tactile materials, and soft contrast.

My current favorite combination: walnut wood + beige linen + brushed brass.

Subtle, timeless, and effortlessly elegant.

What trend are you loving lately?
Activate

Why Space Planning Matters More Than Décor

Many people believe interiors are about colors, furniture, and finishes.
In reality, space planning is the backbone of successful interior design.

At Singhvi Interiors, we educate our clients that good space planning:
✔️ Improves movement & functionality
✔️ Maximizes usable area
✔️ Enhances comfort and efficiency
✔️ Reduces future modification costs
✔️ Aligns design with real-life usage

A beautifully designed space that doesn’t function well will never feel right.
That’s why every project begins with thoughtful layouts, zoning, and flow planning — before aesthetics come in.

👉 Design tip: If your space feels cluttered or underutilized, revisit the plan -not just the décor.

A bathroom should not just be functional — it should feel calm, elegant, and thoughtfully designed.
This 3D bathroom design focuses on creating a clean, luxurious, and highly organized space. Soft marble textures, warm wooden elements, and concealed lighting come together to create a relaxing and modern atmosphere.
The glass shower enclosure keeps the space visually open, while the floating vanity and large mirror enhance the feeling of spaciousness. Open wooden shelving adds both practicality and warmth, making everyday essentials easily accessible while maintaining a minimalist aesthetic.
Every element in this design is carefully balanced — from lighting to material selection — to create a space that feels both sophisticated and comfortable.
Designed with attention to detail by Singhvi Interiors.

This space celebrates bold creativity and modern expression.
 A monochrome pink palette transforms the room into a statement interior for photostudio . playful, artistic, and confidently unique.
The sculptural bathtub becomes the focal point, supported by soft ambient lighting and clean architectural lines. Layered décor, curated wall art, and thoughtful accessories bring personality while maintaining balance and harmony. Every element is intentional, turning the space into an experience rather than just a room.
At Singhvi Interior, we believe interiors should reflect individuality.
 Design is not only about function—it’s about emotion, mood, and storytelling through space.

This design concept beautifully highlights how colors and patterns can create a strong visual impact in interior styling. The blue and white patterned tile arch becomes the main focal point, bringing a classic and artistic feel to the space. The arch shape adds depth and elegance, making the wall look more dynamic and eye-catching.
The warm yellow background perfectly contrasts with the detailed blue patterns, helping the feature wall stand out even more. Decorative ceramic vases and floral arrangements placed around the space add balance and a touch of sophistication. The combination of traditional patterns with modern styling creates a space that feels both vibrant and elegant.
This 3D concept shows how thoughtful placement of decor elements, colors, and textures can transform a simple corner into a stunning design feature.
At Singhvi Interiors, we focus on creating interiors where every detail — from feature walls to decor styling — enhances the overall aesthetic of the space.

A calm space is often created with the simplest elements.
This 3D visual highlights a warm minimal interior concept where natural textures and earthy tones define the atmosphere. The textured beige wall creates a soft backdrop, while the floating wooden shelves add both function and visual balance.
The composition is kept intentionally clean — a low wooden bench, carefully selected décor pieces, sculptural lighting, and neutral pottery elements. The tall floor lamp and soft indirect lighting enhance the warmth of the space, making the room feel inviting and peaceful.
The abstract artwork adds contrast to the neutral palette, while the wooden furniture and natural materials bring depth and character to the design.
This concept focuses on simplicity, texture, and balance — creating a modern interior that feels calm, elegant, and timeless.
Designed & Visualized by Singhvi Interiors
